text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Were you watching ME!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! My body is so hot...! So this 
is the excitement of a GⅠ race!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Good work today, Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, Suzuka! Good work today!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Looks like it was my win today! Good game! 
Thank you, Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No... I'm the one who should be thanking 
you.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I came to thank you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Running with you, feeling your speed 
firsthand—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: There is one thing I've come to see.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: That's why... thank you.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Weeeell...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
—It's okay! I'm glad if I could be of help 
to Suzuka, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"I definitely won't lose next time 
either!! What are we entering next? Which 
race!?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No... I'm going to Hong Kong next. So that 
I don't lose sight of what I've found.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Really!? What an incredible challenger's 
spirit! That's our Suzuka!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"So, this is farewell for a while. ...What 
about you, Taiki? What will you do?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~, I really do want to keep running in 
races where I can make the most of my 
speed, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So, next up should be around the Yasuda 
Kinen, yes~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Mile Championship successfully 
came to a close.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The pinnacle... of speed...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Still. Someday, without fail, I will go 
beyond—!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I called Papa and Mama! They were both 
thrilled, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Still, the real surprise starts now!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll become the "Umamusume of the Year" 
and make everyone even happier, 'kay!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Trainer! Did I manage 
to become the Horse Girl of the Year!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I believe I've done everything I could do 
in the sprint division.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, it is also true that other 
Umamusume have been active throughout the 
year, so—
choice_data_list: Let's wait for the January announcement.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh... You sure like to keep me in 
suspense~

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
At times like that, you train! When you're 
running, January passes by in a flash, 
yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now then, heading toward Horse of the 
Year, let's keep RUNNIIIIING!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While making sure not to slack off on 
preparations for the Yasuda Kinen, we 
awaited the day the "Umamusume of the 
Year" would be announced...
